description: The file is a shell script used for automating Git and Subversion (svn) repository operations, including setup, merging, and testing the behavior of 'git svn dcommit' during merges. It includes functions for displaying license info, sets up repositories, performs commits, merges, and verifies repository states.

methods.name: big_text_block
methods.description: Outputs a large block of copyright and license information related to DENX Software Engineering.
